articleTitle: Reverse Intermodulation Distortion in Current Mode and Bridge Class D RF Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is a continuation of the topic consideration of reverse intermodulation distortions (RIMD) analysis begun by the authors in [1] for class D RF power amplifiers (PA) with a resistive load in the voltage switching mode (Voltage Mode Class D - VMCD). In this article, a theoretical analysis of RIMD in class D RF PA with a resistive load in current switching (CMCD) and bridge (BMCD) modes was carried out. A comparison of the various circuits parameters requirements in order to achieve a given RIMD level not exceeding minus 70 dB showed that: - the VMCD circuit imposes the most stringent requirements for all influencing parameters: the switches saturation resistance variation should not exceed 20%, and the total switches saturation time deviation in any combination should not exceed 0.01, which is 2% from half a period; - the CMCD circuit allows a similar switches saturation time deviation, but the distortion in it does not depend on the difference in switches saturation resistance; - the BMCD circuit allows a 70% difference in the switches saturation resistance. The permissible total switches saturation time deviation depends on the operation mode and is 2.4% for overlapping and 18% for undercovering. The choice of the class D RF PA configuration used in a particular application is based on a large number of factors - efficiency, power level, the ability to work with collector (drain) modulation in a wide frequency range, resistance to load mismatch, element base, etc. The conducted research allows developers to take into account one more parameter - resistance to induced electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Methodology for Organizing Scientific Work in Telecommunications University
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, there is a steady trend towards changes in scientific approaches, the formation of new scientific communities, and the development of many innovative areas. In this regard, the issues of developing the research activities of graduate students as future professionals and engines of progress in all fields of science are becoming increasingly relevant. Each specialist should have an idea about the methodology and organization of research activities, about science and its basic concepts. The article considers the methodology for organizing scientific work on the basis of publication department in telecommunications university. The work is aimed at the formation of predictable results, which guarantees the improvement of authors qualifications and ensures a stable increase in the effectiveness of university's research activities.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Optimal Dispersion Slope and Phase Joint Filtering Algorithm for the Broadband Signal in the Ionospheric Radio Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In HF radio links, an actual task is the increase of the used to transmit information signals bandwidth. One of the significant limitations for increasing the signal bandwidth is the effect of dispersion distortions that occurs in the ionospheric channel and appears for signals with a bandwidth of more than 100 kHz. In addition to the initial estimation and compensation of dispersion distortions, an important task is to track the change in the slope of the dispersion characteristic, which characterizes the effect of dispersion distortions. Also, an important problem is evaluation and tracking the change in the phase of the signal, which is relevant for high-speed radio links with high-order modulations. This paper presents a method for synthesizing the optimal filtering algorithm for the slope of the dispersion characteristic and signal phase, and also confirms the efficiency of the proposed method through a computational experiment.

articleTitle: Application of the Method of Majority Coding to Determine the Optimal Route for Data Transmission in the Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To organize the exchange of data packets between routers in data transmission networks, various routing algorithms and protocols based on these algorithms are used. The vast majority of such algorithms when organizing a route are based on the topology of connections between routers, and the rest take into account the quantitative parameters of these connections, for example, QoS parameters (bandwidth, latency, reliability, etc.) For most networks, the characteristics of transport data flows between any two nodes are determined within the boundaries defined by the quality of service parameters, so it is possible to determine in advance the optimal route trajectory for each of the flows based on the delay parameter. The purpose of this article is to consider issues related to the use of the majority coding method in routing systems to determine the optimal data transmission route in the network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Software Tools Allowing the Development of Cross-Platform Applications for Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the main features and characteristics of frameworks that allow creating cross-platform software for various mobile operating systems. The purpose of the work is to consider the most popular frameworks for cross-platform mobile development, their functionality, to determine the specifics of their use, to identify their advantages and disadvantages, and to provide recommendations for choosing a framework for a number of application requirements. The subject of the research is software tools for developing cross-platform mobile applications. Popular frameworks such as Ionic, Flutter, ReactNative, and Xamarin are considered. The methodological basis of the work is the method of theoretical analysis and the descriptive method, the method of generalization and the comparative method.

articleTitle: Optimization of Network Routing Using the Markov Decision Process and Hamiltonian Cycle
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An infocommunication network is a set of interconnected nodes, the main purpose of which is to transmit information over a certain period of time. Due to the fact that modern networks can include many elements and connections between them for efficient operation, it is necessary to react quickly and process the transmitted data. One of the tools for this is data routing on the network. At the same time, given the nature of the infocommunication network, it can be represented as a queuing system. A random process is characteristic of a queuing system. The study of a random process occurring in a system, expressing it mathematically, is the subject of queuing theory. In such a system, there is always a flow of applications coming into the system from users. The system, in turn, processes applications and returns the result to the user, respectively, it can be concluded that there are both incoming and outgoing flows of applications. This publication is devoted to the optimization of network routing using the Markov decision process and the Hamiltonian cycle.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Data Fabric Architecture as a Sustainable Development of Industrial Platform Technologies in Road Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the problem of implementing the Data Fabric architecture as a technology for sustainable data processing and storage for the modernization of industrial platforms in transport and road systems. To perform complex tasks like monitoring road transport facilities entails huge resources for storing interactive data online. The concept of transport enterprises moving to cloud systems opens up gaps in data management in hybrid and multi-cloud systems. To solve such problems, the implementation of the Data Fabric structure allows you to integrate data and metadata for use on various platforms. The sustainable development of such platforms is facilitated by the use of the Data Fabric mechanism as a built-in system for standardization and coding, the implementation of semantic compatibility, proprietary knowledge graphs and the domain of data values of the transport industry. Data Fabric helps organizations solve complex data problems and use cases by managing their data regardless of application types, platforms, and storage locations, while ensuring seamless data access and sharing in a distributed data environment. The article analyzes the stability of the Data Fabric platform as a domain-oriented decomposition model based on a distributed data architecture with centralized management, but not as a fragmented data warehouse. Using the example of such a decomposition, it is necessary to model an architecture that organizes analytical and other data by areas. In this architecture, the domain's interface with the rest of the organization includes not only operational capabilities, but also access to the analytical data that the domain serves to scale the system.

articleTitle: Classification of Integration Platforms of Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Integrated automation in the transport industry contributes to improving the quality of transport services provided. The introduction of integrated automation in the field of intelligent transport systems (ITS) is possible thanks to the introduction of integration platforms that will allow optimal use of the resources of ITS subsystems. The article describes the main tasks that can be solved using the integration platform. It also describes the main functional characteristics of the integration platform and the place of the integration platform in ITS architectures. Using the example of two implemented projects, the experience of implementing integration is presented.

articleTitle: Determining the Amount of Information in One Information Bit of Text Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: With the rapid growth of the amount of transmitted information in the network and its continuous increase, the need to optimize not only technologies and hardware and software for data transmission, but also to develop an algorithm for preprocessing information for its value to the end user inevitably increases. This article is devoted to the development of such an algorithm. To do this, the essences of natural language processing will be considered, a study will be conducted and the stages of preparing text data for recognition by a machine will be determined, and calculations performed on the text will be carried out, allowing an extensive analysis of text data for its value and identification of patterns in them.

articleTitle: Signal-Code Constructions for Wideband Signals Based on M-Cpfsk and Non-Binary Error-Correcting Codes
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of signal-code structures (SCC) for low-energy broadband radio links. The SCC is based on multi-frequency signals with a continuous phase (M-Cpfsk) and non-binary error-correcting codes (Non-binary low-density parity-check and turbo-like). An analysis is made of signal-code structures for bands up to 10 MHz with different parameters. These signal-code structures can be used for command-telemetry radio links from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAVs).

articleTitle: The Automation of Client Servicing in University and College Admission Office
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Automated customer service using modern infocommunication tools is one of the main technological trends. Chatbots that combine elements of live communication and self-service are very popular. Their main advantage is the ability to serve a large number of requests of the same type. Chatbots reduce the workload on contact center operators and enable them to deal with more complex tasks and issues. The article considered the development of a chatbot for the university admissions office. This is an actual task, since many higher education institutions are still experiencing difficulties in automating responses to routine requests from applicants. Poor information service leads to the loss of potential students. The development of a chatbot is preceded by a sociological study of the main topics of interest to applicants. Further in the text of the article, the process of developing a chat bot is given. The final section describes the mathematical model of the contact center using the chatbot, which will be used in further research.

articleTitle: Development of a Metrological System for Measuring the Characteristics of Single Photon Detectors Based on an Educational Platform EMQOS 1.0
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers a system for measuring the parameters of single photon detectors implemented on the EMQOS 1.0 platform. A description of the experimental setup and its main parameters is presented. The possibility of using the assembled experimental stand for the metrology of photodetectors in the field of telecommunication wavelengths is shown. The results of testing a single photon detector designed for operation in quantum communication systems are presented.

articleTitle: Approach to Substantiating the Effectiveness of the Transition to SLA for Operators of Transport and On-Board Systems Providing Services Over IP Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the era of development of telecommunication technologies, triple-play services via IP networks in real time are of considerable interest both for operators of transport and on-board systems, and for consumers of services. One of the characteristic features of real–time applications is their sensitivity to delays and data packet losses. Even small packet transmission failures can lead to a significant decrease in the quality of audio and video programs. All this imposes additional requirements on operators of transport and on-board systems delivering audio and video streams to content providers, which should be taken into account in their SLA agreements. The article discusses the requirements for IP network operators to deliver audio and video streams with proper quality, and provides an approach to evaluating the operator's performance when switching to SLA work.

Author Keywords: probability of meeting the conditions (requirements) of SLA

articleTitle: Restoration of Complex Signals Distorted by Aliasing as a Result of Bandpass Sub-Nyquist Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of this article is to develop a technique for recovering a complex signal distorted by aliasing as a result of sub-Nyquist bandpass sampling. The developed technique is based on the use of multichannel sampling. Its essence is that the signal is processed in several channels. All channels are analog-to-digital converted with different sampling rates, each of which leads to aliasing in its channel. For each channel, a system of equations is compiled that describes the corresponding aliasing. The joint solution of these systems of equations makes it possible to restore the distorted signal. Consideration in this article is limited only to first-order aliasing, in which no more than two aliases overlap at each frequency. This work is a continuation of the approach developed by the authors, called multichannel multirate sampling.

articleTitle: Using Shaping Filter for Deriving Analytical Models of Spectral Correlation Functions Describing Pulse-Modulated Cyclostationary Random Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper proposes an extension of the shaping filter method for modeling cyclostationary random processes (CSRP) belonging to the subclass of pulse-amplitude modulated signals. The proposed method consists in utilizing an elementary process with cyclostationary properties followed by its subsequent transformation using a linear time-invariant (LTI) system with a known impulse response. The elementary CSRP is chosen to be an infinite sequence of Dirac delta functions uniformly distributed over the time dimension with a constant period. The weights of the Dirac deltas are modeled as independent identically distributed random variables so that it preserves the structural periodicity of the pulse process. The transformation of the sequence by means of the LTI system described by its impulse response makes it possible to obtain the desired shape of the pulses forming the process whose spectral properties can be described by means of its spectral correlation function (SCF). As an simulation example, the derivation of the analytical expression for SCF components is carried out for the sequence modulated with Barker code; the comparison to an uncoded random amplitude pulse modulated sequence is conducted.

articleTitle: Dynamic Measurements Accuracy Increasing of Digital Measuring Device for On-Board Radio Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we discuss the problem of dynamic measurements of digital measuring device for on-board radio electronic equipment. For such a measuring device, when a moving object moves under conditions of influencing noise, the accuracy of measurements decreases. The problem of increasing the accuracy of such dynamic measurements is considered. This article proposes the method for increasing accuracy for on-board radio electronic digital device applied at the moving object with on-board electronic equipment. Theoretical consideration of the accuracy of navigational determinations of the onboard measuring device under noise conditions and taking into account the object's movement dynamics is carried out. The article provides a theoretical analysis and computer simulation of the considered digital measuring device for on-board radio electronic equipment. It has been found that when combining on-board navigation and radio communication facilities are usually used to improve the accuracy of navigation determinations by implementing differential operating modes, it is possible to improve the accuracy of dynamic measurements.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Predicting Pedestrian Behavior on Public Roads
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Human Pose Estimation (HPE) is a way to identify and to classify the nodes of the human body. Essentially, it is a way of determining coordinates of each node (arm, head, torso, etc.) called a key point and defining the position of the human body. The relationship between these points is called a pair. The article analyzes existing approaches to predicting human behavior and compares them. The article contains a comparison and description of tools and technologies for the implementation of human behavior detection systems. It describes the implementation of the system, the development of a module to detect such a sign of deviant behavior as falling, the development of an application that acts as a client application to display notifications of the detection of human falls, manual testing of the implemented program.

articleTitle: Spectrum Occupancy Prediction Algorithm Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The cognitive radio system is a promising solution to the problem of deficit of the radio frequency spectrum. Dynamic spectrum access technology is a key step in the development of these systems. An analysis of the existing methods for predicting the state of the spectrum has shown that it is necessary to solve the problem of long-term forecasting for the effective operation of the dynamic spectrum access technology. The solution of this problem makes it possible to provide this technology with information about the state of occupancy of frequency channels for a long period, thus reducing the probability of interference for the primary user. An algorithm for predicting the spectrum based on neural networks is proposed to solve the problem. The proposed algorithm consists of a technique for generating and preparing input data sets and a recurrent neural network model using a long short-term memory architecture.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation and Comparison of Modulation Types for High Capacity Broadband Transmission System to Support 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the types of modulation that support high-capacity transmission in 5G networks and beyond are discussed. Different types of digital modulation (DP-PSK, DP-QAM) and their impact on the quality of received bits are discussed. Appropriate methods are suggested for transmitting the signal for distances up to 200 km and with an acceptable bit error rate (BER) with acceptable values of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) with totally transmission bit rate approximately 6.4Tb/s. So, we describe the architecture of coherent wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) passive optical networks (PONs) that can back up 5G and future services.

Author Keywords: terabit/s over single mode optic fiber
BER and EVM for DP-PSK and DP-QAM

articleTitle: Methodology of Researching Perception Identity of Regions of Users' Interests While Viewing Streaming Video Containing Various Content and Compression Artefacts
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Over the past two decades, eye-tracking devices have become significant due to continuous research and development in non-invasive eye-tracking solutions. Since the data generated by eye tracking devices can be used for a better understanding of human behavior and cognitive processes, the technology is applicable to a wide range of research areas, including telecommunications. In the presented work, the dependence of the change in the user's perception areas when re-watching a video with different media content and compression artifacts is considered. Proposed work presented the comparative analysis of the user's perception areas repeatability finding of viewing streaming video content will be given. A methodology for researching and measuring the identity of the regions of user interest perception when re-viewing streaming videos containing different content and compression artefact will also be presented

articleTitle: Ultra-Reliable Communications: Basic Concepts, Challenges and Open Issues
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the upcoming 5G and beyond systems, ultra-reliable communications are designed to provide various mission-critical services (industrial automation, remote healthcare, intelligent transportation, etc.). However, the requirements for the reliability of such systems have not yet received clear and unambiguous formulations. In this article, the basic concepts and measures related to reliability are discussed. In addition, some potential research topics and challenges are also identified. These include determining failure criteria, accounting for common cause failures in redundant systems, and selecting an economically feasible level of reliability.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study on the Detection of a Cyclostationary Signal buried in a Stationary Noise for Unknown Power Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper deals with the detection problem aiming at revealing the presence of a wide-sense cyclostationary process in correlated wideband and narrowband stationary noises while the power of both processes assumed unknown. It is shown incapability of using energy detector in such scenario. The six cyclostationary detector statistics based on a single slice taken along the cyclic frequency out of the estimated spectral correlation function are under consideration. The performance of the detectors implementing the proposed statistics is evaluated and compared via Monte Carlo simulations by example of a base-band BPSK signal. The performance advantages are measured in terms of receiver operating curves and the probability of detection versus signal-to-noise ratio

articleTitle: Implementation of the Format of Video Lectures for Disciplines of the Department of General Communication Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a methodology for introducing video lectures into the educational process of students studying the disciplines of the department ”General Theory of Communication”. The process of preparing electronic material, a teleprompter, multimedia presentations with the brand of the university, as well as recording videos with lecturers is considered step by step. The introduction of video lectures in the ”Electronic University” system will allow full-time students to repeat the lecture material in a convenient format, and provide additional material for self-study for part-time students. Also, the format of video lectures will be useful in the implementation of additional professional education programs.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Learning in Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An important problem of intelligent data processing of system logs is the existence of data sets containing records with multiple associations of class labels. Research objective: To formalize the problem of multi-label classification of experimental data (binary or multi-class) on the example of computer networks (CN) log records. Novelty: consists in illustrating the presence of multi-label class labels in the analysis of system log records generated by the CN. Results: It is shown that the problem of multivaluedness of system log class labels is relevant for the analysis of accessibility and integrity of information circulating in the CN.

articleTitle: Service Speed for Self-Driving Cars
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the concept of the methodology for calculating the service speed for self-driving cars. Service speed is the speed that is primarily safe in the current traffic situation and most comfortable from the point of view of psychophysiology for all passengers in the vehicle cabin. The service speed will be part of the mobility service with the help of unmanned vehicles and should be provided to each user as a basic component of a comprehensive unmanned mobility service. The presented concept implies that an integrated approach to data collection will be used. To calculate the service speed, data from the external and internal technical vision of an unmanned vehicle, as well as from cooperative intelligent transport systems and a digital traffic model should be used. The described concept can be used to create algorithms for controlling highly automated vehicles, as well as for creating intelligent transport systems, including for creating algorithms based on artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Implementation of Electronic Educational and Methodological Complexes for Students of IT Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the use of such a form of support for the educational process as electronic textbooks, multimedia presentations and video lectures as part of the electronic educational and methodological complex for the online environment "Electronic University". This form of electronic learning tools can be used to modernize higher education, both in distance and traditional education. In particular, this format is most in demand by students of the Information Technology majors, since students are interested in working with personal computers, the global network and online tools and learn materials of this format much more efficiently.

articleTitle: The Use of an Alternative Fuel in an Internal Combustion Engine with the Effect of Auto-Ignition
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Annotation. This article discusses the use of an alternative fuel type in internal combustion engines (ICE), which is based on the self-ignition effect. A comparative table of the main characteristics of dimethyl ether and diesel fuel with an ultra-low sulfur content is formed. An adaptive scheme for introducing an alternative fuel supply system for internal combustion engines has been developed, with subsequent analysis of design features. Graphs of the effect of injection conditions on fuel injection speed characteristics are presented. The distribution of droplets of two types of power plant power supplies by size was analyzed. A qualitative study of the results of the amounts of emissions of the main types of pollutants into the atmosphere in comparison with diesel fuel was carried out, and the corresponding graphs were formed on the basis of the obtained data. In the course of the conducted research, a conclusion was formulated that allows evaluating the effectiveness of using this type of alternative fuel in internal combustion engines with the effect of auto-ignition.

articleTitle: Multi-Band Bandpass Microstrip Filters Based on Two Codirectional Hairpin Resonators
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we study the frequency properties of structures based on two multistep codirectional hairpin resonators, which provide the possibility to realize one-, two-, tri-, and four-band filters under certain conditions. The authors show that these two-resonator filters have increased frequency selectivity due to the formation by them of a significant number of working attenuation poles, which are four times greater than the number of resonators in the filter. For these structures, topological differences are determined, and the mechanisms of formation of their frequency characteristics are studied. The article shows that the considered two-resonator structures combine compactness, increased frequency selectivity, and reduced loss level.

Author Keywords: poles and zeros of working attenuation

articleTitle: Agricultural Robot Software with Machine Vision and Cognitive Artificial Intelligence Module
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Article discusses the results of software development for growth and development automating processes the crops based on the artificial intelligence algorithms introduction. The main features of the developed software when using the parallelizing video capture streams method are highlighted. Algorithms for the mobile and server parts of the cognitive module are developed, and its construction features are described. Server part program interface sample of the cognitive module obtained in the development course is given. The functional part list that software module performs during its operation is listed. The conclusion part that allows usage of developed software in order to automate and improve various agricultural plants fruit formation processes, while physical intervention factor on them minimizing is obtained.

articleTitle: Monitoring of RF-Field Strength in the Environment by Mobile Telecommunications in the Moscow
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The growing popularity and use of the wireless Internet of Things and cyber-physical systems increase the demand for "green" technologies in the field of mobile telecommunications. To be completely wireless, such devices need an integrated RF energy harvesting system that ensures efficient recharging of the batteries and accumulators used in them. This article provides an assessment of the coverage areas of mobile operators in Moscow and the Moscow region by the frequency ranges used, taking into account the power distribution. An experimental study of the RF-field strength of telecommunication equipment was carried out using a log periodic antenna (KM6-600/6000) with linear polarization and a portable spectrum analyzer with an Arinst SSA-TG R2 tracking generator. The results of attenuation of electromagnetic waves of GSM and Wi-Fi bands under various environmental conditions are obtained, which is of interest for the development of effective intelligent harvesting systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Influence of the Radio Receiving Devices Heterodynes Functioning Quality on the Quadrature Amplitude Modulation Digital Signals Reception Noise Immunity
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In digital transmission lines with quadrature amplitude modulation of signals the information is contained in the change in the amplitude and phase transmission of the signal. Therefore, in comparison with other types of modulation, there are more stringent requirements for the level of phase noise of the signal at the input of the QAM-signal demodulator, leading to a decrease in the reliability of reception. This article will consider the requirements for short-term frequency stability of synthesizers of transmission lines, which use signals of multi-position quadrature-amplitude modulation in conjunction with quasi-coherent reception of these signals. The carrier is extracted on the receiving side directly from the received QAM-signal using a carrier recovery device by demodulating the received signal and then its subsequent narrow-band filtration. As a narrow-band tunable filter, an auto-tuning frequency switching system is used. With the improvement in the filtering quality of the demodulated signal, the phase fluctuations of the restored carrier associated with the action of additive noise are reduced, the energy losses of the applied quasi-coherent reception are reduced in comparison with the ideal one, which requires the complete absence of the phase error of the selected reference signal. The approximation of the noise immunity of real coherent QAM-signal demodulators to the theoretical one limits the phase noise of the signal at the input of the demodulator associated with the imperfection of the frequency synthesizers on the transmitting and receiving sides of digital communication lines.

Author Keywords: spectral power density of phase noise

articleTitle: Digital Signal Generators Based on the Lorentz System Implemented Using Fixed-Point Numbers
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The results of the study of signal shapers based on the Lorentz system with dynamic chaos in its implementation using fixed-point number representation are presented in this paper. An approach to modifying systems with dynamic chaos based on fixed-point numbers to achieve disruption-free signal generation is proposed. The analysis of the senior Lyapunov exponent of the floating-point, fixed-point and modified fixed-point system is performed. The closeness of the senior Lyapunov exponents for the considered systems is shown.

articleTitle: Design and Research of an Antenna Array for a Satellite Communication System in the 435 MHz Band
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In one of the previous articles of our research team, it was described the development and research of a ground-based tracking antenna system for receiving information from low-orbit spacecraft using two Yagi-Uda antennas of different ranges. This article is devoted to the design of an antenna array of four 435 MHz antennas in order to improve the efficiency of information reception by increasing the gain and directivity. During the preliminary stage, basic calculations were carried out to determine the number of required elements in the array, after which the proposed array was modeled using Ansys HFSS software tools. The model showed a realized gain of 17 dB with a beamwidth of approximately 17 degrees in the horizontal and vertical planes at half power. The article also includes the design of an antenna adder and the calculation of the distance to the spacecraft, at which it is possible to receive signals from its transmitter.

articleTitle: Research of the Electrodynamic Parameters of UHF RFID Tags
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents the results of modeling a passive RFID tag MG6 in the range of 860-960 MHz with a known topology, focused on identification applications of tagged objects. The tag is located on a flexible substrate, which entails changes in the electrodynamic characteristics during flexible deformations. The most typical forms of flexible deformations during operation are considered. The work is focused on the study of the main electrodynamic parameters of antennas: S11, VSWR, radiation pattern, as well as the influence of the geometric bends of the tag on them. The following shapes were used to model flexible bends: a cylindrical surface with different radii, a wedge surface, and an elliptical cylinder surface. Numerical simulation results show that the characteristics of the antenna under study can have significant changes, including the worse side, after changes in the geometric shape of the tag itself.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport Systems Software as a Source of Transport Security Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the threats to transport security associated with the shortcomings of the software used in intelligent transport systems. Examples of transport security incidents caused by such shortcomings are given. Ways to neutralize threats from the ITS software to transport security are formulated. Attention was drawn to the possibility of monitoring the security of ITS software throughout the life cycle

articleTitle: M-Sequence Based Partial Transmit Sequence PAPR Reduction Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a multi-carrier modulation technology used in many wireless digital communication systems. It has many advantages, but one of its disadvantages is its high peak to average power ratio (PAPR). The report presents the results of a study of the influence of the number of windows, iterations, choice of phase sequence, as well as the randomness of the information signal on the improvement of the complementary cumulative distribution function (CCDF) using the conventional and modified method of reducing the crest factor by partial transmission sequence (PTS) signal with OFDM. Graphs of the resulting peak factor are presented.

articleTitle: Space-Frequency Beamforming Algorithms Comparison with a Circular Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The interference cancellation problem for the satellite navigation systems is considered. The space-frequency adaptive processing algorithms that use the digital beamforming technique are described. Different beamformers with and without the interference sources number (ISN) and directions (ISD) determination are presented. The algorithms of filter input signal sample correlation matrix calculation and inversion, the ISN and ISD determination and the processing quality function extremum search are described. The computer modelling of processing of real satellite signals recorded with use of a circular antenna array using the suggested algorithms is implemented. The comparative analysis of the performance quality of the processing algorithms and their separate inner procedures is carried out. The algorithms with the best performance quality metrics are identified. The validity of the jamming suppression problem solution using the suggested algorithms and the possibility of using them in the real interference-protected satellite navigation systems are confirmed.

articleTitle: Analytical Queueing Model of Functioning of the On-board Navigation Complex Database
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Ensuring flight safety is a priority for the development of modern both civil and military aviation. In particular, navigation systems and on-board information systems being developed to improve safety. Database is the kernel of a modern on-board complex and information system. At the initial stage of design of such systems, it is necessary to construct their functioning effective models. You can use both analytical and simulation models for it. When construct an analytical model of the database of the on-board computing complex, it is necessary to take into account many factors, including the nature of the allocating law of input flows and of the service time of of queries. In this article constructed an example of such model. To show assess the adequacy of the model, a comparison of analytical results and simulation modeling given.

articleTitle: Modeling of Partially Filled Waveguide Structures with Magnetic Walls on a Mushroom-Shaped Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Nowadays composite structures with unusual properties not found in nature called metamaterials are becoming increasingly popular and are widely used in microwave engineering. In this paper, we apply mushroom metamaterials as wide walls of a rectangular waveguide and present modeling results for three different waveguide structures. In the first part of the paper, a computer simulation of a partially dielectric-filled rectangular waveguide with a cross section of 74.14 mm by 34.04 mm is presented. The dielectric plate is placed parallel to the wide wall of the waveguide. In the second part, the dielectric plate in the waveguide is replaced with a magnetic wall made of mushroom metamaterial. In the third part, a waveguide with two magnetic walls is investigated. In the course of modeling, the frequency dependences of the distribution of complex reflection and transmission coefficients, as well as the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) are obtained for the three designs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Monitoring Data of the Street-Road Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes the results obtained during the monitoring of the street-road network in 2018–2020. The technology of monitoring is described and the need for the use of mobile road laboratories is justified. The proposed approach for solving the problem of automating the monitoring of street and road network objects is reduced to finding and recording the object, as well as determining its impact on the overall condition of each section of the street and road network using the solution table and making recommendations for repair and restoration work. The results of diagnostics of the street and road network by complex of multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of the objects of the road network "Automated Road Scanner", during which the following parameters were controlled: longitudinal evenness, transverse evenness, crack density, density of road repair charts, are presented. A comparative analysis of diagnostic results was carried out to identify the causes of deviations of controlled parameters from the normative values. Prospects for the development of information and software for the objects to be repaired are determined. The need to develop an intelligent decision support system for planning repairs is justified

articleTitle: Classification of NOMA Schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Recently various non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) schemes have been proposed for 5G and 6G communication systems. Although there are a number of publications devoted to NOMA classification, general NOMA systems classification approach is not fully developed. The purpose of this report is to make common classification of various NOMA schemes and to propose new generalized model of NOMA signals for the further optimization of communication systems using NOMA technologies. Such new classification approach allows deeper analysis of NOMA characteristics, as well as developing NOMA theory in order to optimize and further improve such communication systems.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Power of Algebraic Geometric Codes Designed to Construct a Post-Quantum Algorithm for Ensuring Information Security of On-board Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper continues the study of a post-quantum algorithm built on the basis of algebro-geometric codes, begun in previous works, in the interests of ensuring the information security of the Internet of things systems and on-board communication systems under the conditions of a quantum threat. The paper presents similar codes, the power of which lies above the Gilbert–Varshamov bound, and which can withstand known attacks on algorithms built on the basis of error-correcting codes.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of Noise Based Camera Measurements Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Nowadays digital cameras are being used in many practical applications. Therefore, problem of parameter estimation and quality evaluation becoming more and more significant. Recently computational photography trend become more notable and many devices started to use advanced algorithms to mask out weak characteristics of hardware. This makes traditional deterministic approaches of measurement less relevant. But random methods used these days have limitations too. This article compares measurement approaches and highlights limitation of each case and brings recommendation for measuring process creating foundation for future measuring method development.

articleTitle: Modeling an Efficient Storage Method Information Based on Unary Coding
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study is devoted to the development of an effective lossless data compression method based on unary coding. In previous materials, the fundamental possibility of hardware implementation of encoding based on encoders and decoding based on decoders was shown. The presented materials provide an algorithm for the software implementation of the proposed method of information compression. Based on the proposed algorithm, software has been developed that allows creating a model of mutually orthogonal unary codes. Mathematical calculations of the practical feasibility of the proposed method are given, which are confirmed by the model. A program written in Octave, which is a freely distributed analogue of the proprietary application package MatLab, is presented. It is shown that the sequences used in the method of unary information coding are mutually orthogonal. This property, revealed in the process of research, makes it possible to implement the proposed method. In addition, additional compression methods are considered that allow increasing the entropy after applying the unary coding of information

articleTitle: Software Demo Versions of Modern Measuring Equipment Using for Telecommunication Disciplines Studying
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Methods of modern measuring equipment software trials usage for the telecommunication studying process are analyzed in the paper. Vector Spectrum Analyzer Signal Hound SM200C was chosen as an example. The computer analysis technique of signals recorded with the help of Signal Hound SM200C is described. The special program named "Spike" is used for the analysis execution. A conjugation algorithm of the Spike program is proposed. It allows conducting the study of signals generated in other software products.

articleTitle: Fiber – Optical Lines Reliability: The Economic Aspect
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: High-speed telecommunications fiber-optical cable lines reliability refers to the dominant factors of ensuring their economic efficiency. Telecommunications operator's income loss due to the data transmission services failures caused by communications breakdowns or the service life shortening depends directly on the cable lines capacity which increases year by year. The paper presents telecommunication fiber-optical cable lines reliability and durability quantifications. Fiber-optical cable trouble-free operation probability in external and internal damages influence is estimated. The optical fiber destruction cumulative danger in free position (and) under bending and torsion is being calculated. The fiber-optical cable lines service life is determined by the energy reserve exhaustion due to losses increase caused by additional attenuation of cable inserts in linear transmission path during damage restoration works. The analytical expressions of faults duration, the fiber-optical cable line service life average and gamma percent values, the income loss due to data transmission services failures are given. Income losses in monetary units are given for a line with an operating frequency band in the optical ranges S.L, the number of spatial channels I...I2, the idle coefficients IO 10, the service life shortening 1...3 years.

articleTitle: Fiber-Optical System for Measuring the Temperature of the KAI-1 Cubesat
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a description of one of the payloads of a small-sized spacecraft (cubesat nanosatellite, size 3U) - a fiber-optic temperature meter based on Bragg gratings. The above review of implemented similar projects on the introduction of Bragg sensors for monitoring the state of individual loaded elements of spacecraft in the United States and the European Union shows the promise of this area of research. The meter is based on a traditional circuit that converts the wavelength shift of the Bragg grating of the sensor into a change in the amplitude of the reflected signal. A description of the block diagram, its key components, as well as the results of calibration and testing of the meter in space is given. Based on the preliminary results, the topics of future missions implemented within the framework of the Planet Duty Program of the Innovation Assistance Fund were formulated.

articleTitle: Fiber-Optic Temperature Sensor Based on a Phase Shift
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the course of the work, an analysis of existing temperature control solutions was carried out. Their advantages and disadvantages are identified, on the basis of this, a solution is proposed that allows to eliminate a number of these disadvantages. Also, in the process of work, mathematical and computer modeling of the proposed solution was carried out. In the course of which the measuring characteristics were obtained and proposals were developed for the further development of sensors of this type.

articleTitle: The Energy Spectrum of the Noise Modulation Function under the Influence of Slow Multiplicative Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The effect of slow multiplicative noise on the energy spectrum of the noise modulation function is analyzed. Two cases of determining the energy spectrum are considered: with signal distortions described by a narrow-band normal stationary random process, and under the influence of pulse-fluctuation noise. The corresponding mathematical expressions of the energy spectra are obtained, including the case of deep phase distortions. It is shown that when narrow-band multiplicative noise affects the signal, a discrete component is present in the energy spectrum of the noise modulation function. Wherein the depth of the phase distortions will determine the power of said discrete component. The distribution pattern of the continuous part of the energy spectrum of phase distortion is determined by the ratio of the width of the named spectrum to its average frequency. With pulse-fluctuation modulating noise with a deterministic clock interval, the energy spectrum of the noise modulation function is the sum of continuous and discrete parts. Expressions are obtained for determining the discrete and continuous parts of the energy spectrum of the noise modulation function under the influence of modulation noise. The conditions under which the spectrum consists only of discrete components are given.

articleTitle: Method for Diagnosing the Ultimate Bandwidth of Variable Transionospheric Radio Communication Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Today, the development of satellite communication technologies is particularly important for the Russian Federation. To ensure high throughput when transmitting and receiving information, it's necessary to adapt wide bands of radio channels in satellite systems. The primary task is to estimate the current values of the limiting bands under various conditions of a changing transionospheric radio channel. To accomplish this task, the method for diagnosing the limiting frequency band for a variable transionospheric radio channel has been modernized. This was done by analyzing and processing a large amount of data from a network of reference base stations and introducing a reference frequency into the mathematical model of frequency dispersion. This made it possible to separate the influence of geophysical factors, associated with changes in the TEC of the ionosphere, from technical factors such as operating frequency and channel bandwidth. In general, the method is based on experimental estimates of the current values of the coherence bands, which take into account variations in the dispersion and TEC of the ionosphere. The presented results indicate that by taking into account dispersion variations in its diagnostics, it's possible to obtain an increase in the frequency band up to 2.5 times from the minimum possible value.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Information Systems Management Through the Introduction of the Authority Criticality Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The organization of information processes management, as well as information systems of a large retail company, is influenced by many factors. One of the fundamental factors is risk management. The desire to minimize risks is often accompanied by the use of additional methods at the design stage of complex information systems, which will later be used to automate the company's information processes. Management of organizational systems requires automation of many processes to reduce possible errors. The authority criticality matrix allows you to predict risks before the implementation stage. Using this method allows you to maintain a balance of security and efficiency of a complex system, which in the final stage significantly improves its operation and simplifies the management process.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Safety of an Autonomous Object, Taking Into Account the Movement of Other Road Users
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to modeling a subsystem to ensure the safe movement of an autonomous object. The influence of other vehicles on safety is considered. To determine the position of various traffic participants, it is proposed to predict their position after a certain time interval. Vehicle location data can be obtained from local sensors. Global positioning is used when building a route for an autonomous object. To ensure the processing of large amounts of data, it is proposed to use neural networks. They can perform real-time calculations, which is important for autonomous operation. A combination of neural networks is used to predict the position of objects and to select a safe trajectory. This makes it possible to take into account the possible exit of vehicles moving along the sidewalk onto the carriageway. The simulation was carried out in the C# programming language

articleTitle: The Special Aspects of Chinese Teaching Methodology for Radio Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The progress in the field of radio engineering contributes to extending the term "base". This article analyzes radio engineering specification terminology mainly used in scientific-technical terminology of the Chinese language, describes the scientific-technical language specification at the lexical level, and provides the teaching methodology for terminological vocabulary for radio-engineering students studying Chinese. The analysis focuses on the main specifications of the morphemic structure, pronunciation, semantics, lexical hierarchy, and formation and nominalization mechanisms. It proposes a terminological teaching methodology to implement the basic vocabulary beginning in the first lesson.

Author Keywords: scientific-technical terminology of the Chinese language
teaching terminological vocabulary and methodology for radio-engineering students

articleTitle: Simulation of the Working Process of a Dual-Fuel Engine to Determine the Impact of the Parameters of the Pilot Portion of Diesel Fuel on its Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Because dual-fuel engine must operate efficiently in the diesel mode, there are not many ways to perfect the combustion of gas fuel. One of the main tools for improving the performance of a dual-fuel engine is to adjust the parameters of the diesel fuel ignition doze. A simulation research was carried out using the AVL FIRE software package to estimate the impact of the basic parameters of the ignition doze of diesel fuel on fuel economy, peak cylinder pressure, harmful emissions and power of automotive dual-fuel engine. The influence of the injection advance angle, injection duration and the share of the ignition doze of diesel fuel were studied. The injection rate characteristic of the ignition doze of diesel fuel calculated using a software package for modeling parameters of the fuel system is presented. Calculations by the AVL FIRE model show that a decrease in the diesel fuel injection advance angle can reduce significantly emissions of nitrogen oxides NOx and unburned methane CH4. An increase in the diesel fuel injection duration makes it possible to reduce significantly NOx and CH4 emissions with a slight deterioration in effective indicators, and a decrease in the ignition doze of diesel fuel leads to a drop of NOx emissions.

Author Keywords: engine conversion for operation on natural gas
parameters of diesel fuel pilot portion

articleTitle: Virtual Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems Tests
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the issue of testing highly automated vehicles (HAVs). Particular attention is paid to virtual testing using hardware-software complex (HSC). Siemens PreScan is used as a software implementation environment for HSC. A technique for testing vision aids based on radar sensors as part of an automatic emergency braking system (AEBS) is proposed. Special attention is paid to the influence of such effects as atmospheric attenuation of radio waves, as well as occlusion. A methodology is also proposed for conducting virtual tests of the effectiveness of LANE SUPPORT SYSTEMS (LSS). The methodology includes test scenarios implemented in various weather and road conditions in the Advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) testing software package. Test scenarios for virtual simulation were developed based on the ISO 17361:2007 test type: changeover to the left lane on a straight section of road through a broken marking line. The results of virtual testing according to the proposed methodology for the effectiveness of the Lane departure warning (LDW) system of the Audi A8 are presented. A monochrome video camera is used as a technical vision device for the operation of the LDW system.

articleTitle: Methodology for Determining the Minimum Capacity of Traction Batteries of Electric Buses Based on the Operational Characteristics of Routes Using Artificial Intelligence Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The authors have developed a method for determining the minimum capacity of traction batteries of electric buses with ultrafast charging for operation on regular routes. The calculation is based on a cluster analysis of the general set of regular routes of an operational enterprise, as well as an artificial intelligence tool (decision tree) developed and trained by the authors to predict battery power consumption. The article presents the results of testing the developed methodology for determining the minimum capacity of traction batteries of electric buses for operation on the route network. The results obtained can be useful not only for operational enterprises, but also for manufacturers of electric buses with ultrafast charging to optimize their design in terms of completing batteries of the required capacity for various customers.

articleTitle: 5G Data Transmission System Radio Link Layout Using FBMC Based Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The most critical problem for cellular communication systems at the present time is to increase the spectral efficiency of the used signal code structures. The orthogonal frequency division multiplexing used in actual fourth and fifth generation systems requires the addition of a cyclic prefix to make system able to operate on memory channels. This paper presents a SDR based model of a radio link with the distribution of physical resources according to the 5G standard and multiplexing using the filterbank multicarrier technology, which eliminates the need to use a cyclic prefix, which allows us to increase spectral efficiency of the system by excluding the cyclic prefix.

articleTitle: Development of a Hardware and Software Complex for Optimizing Logistics Activities in the Field of Consumer Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the problems associated with servicing the population in the field of solid municipal waste removal from garbage containers/bunkers. The authors propose a concept for the development of a software and hardware complex consisting of a device for collecting, processing and transmitting information, which is equipped with garbage containers / bunkers, and special software that uses the transmitted information. The device proposed by the authors is equipped with sensors of filling, smell, location, which allows operators for the removal and disposal of waste to optimize logistics activities due to the timeliness of waste removal, minimizing idle runs. The authors have developed an algorithm for constructing a detour route for containers in need of export, which is based on a genetic algorithm, as well as information received from sensors. The approach proposed by the authors will help solve a number of other problems in the field of waste management by controlling the timeliness of their removal.

articleTitle: Model of Mobile Web Service for Booking a Parking Space Based on Multi-channel Queue System with Discipline of Prioritized Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical model of mobile web service for booking а parking spaces in parking lots has been developed. It is assumed that web service operators receive requests of different priorities. First of all, the possibility of providing a place in the nearest parking lot for the vehicle is considered. The request is granted if, after accepting the request, there is free parking space in the parking lot that is not less than the amount reserved for requests of higher priorities. Delays occur when there is not enough free parking space or when there are no free operators. In the case of refusal to provide a parking space, the request goes to another parking lot, etc. The model is a queue system with the discipline of sharing capacity of serving devices. A simulation model has been created to estimate the performing time of booking requests. A numerical example and the results of a simulation experiment are given.

articleTitle: QAM Signal Demodulator with One and a Half Symbol Per Sample
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses a new QAM signal demodulation algorithm operating at a clock speed of 1.5 sample per symbol. The demodulation algorithm implements a modified adaptive equalizer scheme that allows clock synchronization recovery and detecting a signal at a rate of 2 modulation symbols per 3 signal samples without loss of quality. The basic version of the demodulation scheme is presented in the continuous signal processing variant. In this case, the algorithm of adaptive clock synchronization recovery is used a modification of adaptive "blind" equalization. The presented algorithm can also be effectively used for block signal demodulation. In this case, a scheme is presented using the adjustment of the equalizer coefficients on the unique word and pilot symbols. The developed algorithm, in comparison with classical demodulation schemes, has a lower computational complexity and, without reducing the noise immunity, operates with an input signal sampling rate corresponding to 1.5 samples per modulation symbol. The conducted research relates to the development of receiving devices of communication systems using PAK/QAM signal modulation in their channels. The results obtained can be used in the development of demodulation schemes for satellite, radio relay and optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Cloud Data Formats Transformation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In cloud infocommunication systems built using open source components, there is a mismatch in various formats or data structures, which is revealed when maintaning such systems. The article assumes such data formats as YAML, JSON and XML and here is put a hypothesis about the possibility of converting various formats to a single format. Relying on the analysis results of the real data samples from cloud components, three possible options of the structure are proposed. The second hypothesis was to verify the possibility of combining data from several sources. After writing code fragments on Python language and taking experiments an algorithm for transforming the original data was proposed. The proposed algorithm is tested on real data samples and its convergence on a large sample met suitable conditions for the maintenance automation purpose.

articleTitle: Two-frequency DSB-SC Modulation for Relative Frequency Response Measurement of Mach-Zehnder Amplitude Modulators
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Electro-optical and optoelectronic devices are widely used in the field of on board telecommunications, microwave photonics, and fiber optic sensing. Measurement of the spectral characteristics of these devices with high resolution is necessary both at the stage of their production and operation. However, using currently existing methods, it is hardly possible to effectively characterize these devices, which practically have an arbitrary response, due to the low resolution or high cost of existing measuring instruments. This article will use the basic principles of the concept of an ultra-narrow-band discrete frequencies package to build a microwave photonic spectral characteristics analyzer (MPSCA) of an amplitude electro-optical Mach-Zehnder modulator based on the double conversion of a laser carrier into a symmetric two-frequency radiation using the Il’in-Morozov method, and characterized by a high resolution at low cost. At the same time, unlike the existing MPSCA, the proposed implementation is distinguished by a universal element base, a reasonable choice of a difference frequency between two components of 50 MHz, which determines the measurement resolution, and also by obtaining an information signal tied to zero at the output.

articleTitle: Participatory Design as a Tool for Optimizing an Intelligent Transport System
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Current trends in the design of road systems are driven by the digitalization process. Work on the introduction of intelligent transport systems is being carried out all over the world, because the improvement of the road network is an important element in creating comfortable conditions for the movement of people in an urbanized environment; a tool for improving road safety. Based on interdisciplinary research methods in the framework of urban planning, the paper proposes a methodology for assessing the prospects for the development of an intelligent city transport system within the framework of the concept of participatory design. The formation of the transport system is seen as a process of coordination of institutional and civil needs. The goal of the joint work of urban planners and civil society is to improve the safety of road infrastructure, not only through the development and implementation of quality standards, but also through the internalization (recognition) of the value of new technologies by the society. It is necessary to introduce the principles of participatory design of the transport system into the development of the road network, the urban space should remain free for co-creation. The problem of the study is that technologies for improving road safety, including the use of artificial intelligence, automation systems for traffic management processes depending on the rhythm of the city, weather conditions, time of day (traffic flow detectors, CCTV cameras, "smart traffic lights", weather stations, vehicle traffic sensors, navigation information systems, weather information display systems, environmental pollution sensors, traffic control centers, etc.) can be perceived by citizens primarily as devices that restrict freedom of movement, and not as means of improving road safety

articleTitle: Analysis of Application-Level Load Balancing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The present article examines the application-level load balancing strategies employed in the microservice architecture of IoT servers, which use wireless communication protocols like Wi-Fi to exchange radio signals among IoT devices. Load balancing at the application level is a crucial task, add to address it, a hypothesis is proposed. To evaluate the effectiveness of various load balancing algorithms, mathematical models based on queuing theory are developed for four algorithms: Round Robin, Weighted Round Robin, Least Connection, and search of the optimal vector. A numerical analysis is conducted to compare the performance of these algorithms. The results confirm the aforementioned hypothesis, and highlight the need to develop a load balancing algorithm that can account for error coefficients arising from distinct services.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Multiplicative Noise on the Patterns of Phased and Synthesized Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The influence of multiplicative noise on the directional patterns of phased and synthesized antenna arrays is analyzed. Multiplicative noise is regarded as a source of fast phase and amplitude distortion of signals received or radiated by the antenna. It is shown that multiplicative noise changes the multiplier of the array. Expressions of the directional pattern of the phased array exposed to multiplicative noise are obtained, taking into account the aperture distribution of phasing errors, as well as a generalized directional pattern of the array with phase shifters. The features of arrays with delay lines are described, and an expression for determining the directional pattern of such arrays is obtained. The features of synthesized antenna arrays are considered. The directional pattern of a focused antenna array under the influence of multiplicative noise is analyzed. Expressions for the directional pattern are obtained taking into account the time of the relative delay of signal reception relative to the central element of the array. It is shown that the obtained expressions for the phased antenna array and the array with phase shifters are also valid for synthesized antenna arrays.

articleTitle: Developing an AI-System for Analyzing Games of Team Sports Using VR/AR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a new method for training athletes competing in team sports, which is based on the processing of video recordings of games and performances in virtual and augmented reality. The system solves the tasks of object detection, tracking and re-identification of athletes, obtaining their three-dimensional pose, their texture and field marking, combining data from different cameras and presentation of the resulting data in three-dimensional space with the possibility of user interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Spectrums in Heart Signals to Detect the Presence of Low-Amplitude High-Frequency Components
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Purpose of this study is effective registration of low-amplitude high-frequency components with predictive value - ventricular late potentials (VLPs) - in electrocardiosignals (ECS) by Ist standard lead. 232 signals were preliminary evaluated to detect VLPs by Simson’s method. VLPs were detected in 34 signals. Modification of signal-averaged approach was applicated to analyzed signals. Power spectrums of heartbeat signals’ terminal part were analyzed in this study. Designed algorithm showed 82.75% of correct decisions. Originality: new parameter to detect VLPs by Ist standard lead lead was proposed. Parameter’s threshold value is calculated. Threshold frequencies with maximal percentage of correct decisions were determined. Opportunity to detect VLPs in signals by Ist standard was evaluated: it is possible to detect VLPs using spectral analysis. Practical significance: results will be useful for ECS analysis block in telemedicine systems and onboard communications.

articleTitle: Identification of the Nature of Threats to the Economic and Functional Security of Intelligent Onboard Systems and the Selection of Protection by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of ensuring economic security in the field of development and production of intelligent on-board systems is considered by choosing the optimal set of operations and measures of an organizational and technological nature, identifying and analyzing the cause-and-effect nature of threats and choosing adequate measures to counter them according to the criterion of optimal expected costs or maximum security with restrictions in the form of given allowable costs for them. Its solution is proposed by machine learning methods and evolutionary optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Application of Multivariate State Estimation Technique for Early Detection of Potential Threats while Driving a Truck
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Existing telematic monitoring systems for the state of functioning parameters and characteristics of cars and other mobile equipment make it possible to obtain a large amount of digital data on the state of objects of observation in real time. At the same time, it is possible to evaluate the features and current characteristics of their control parameters by the driver or operator. The paper proposes a fundamental possibility of obtaining predictive information about the features of changes in the characteristics of driving a vehicle by a driver based on the analysis of information received from telematic control of transport information, a block diagram of an information-mathematical system and the principles of mathematical processing of incoming information are proposed.
