The paper presents some results of the analysis of the time series of the selected vehicle monitoring parameters, which allow applying the Multivariate State Estimation Technique (MSET) method to their assessment in order to obtain the possibility of early detection of a potential emergency situation in driving a car (falling asleep, driver fatigue, stressful situations, inappropriate behavior). The results of the study can become prerequisites for a larger-scale application of MSET methods in monitoring the operation of mobile equipment and assessing the characteristics of its control.

articleTitle: Assessment of Information Capacity of Compressed Video Sequences for Information Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: During the exponential increase in online video streaming services, the development of information concealment technologies directly depends on video encoding and is essential for video streaming companies. The structure of the video remains to contain areas invisible to humans and can be used to conceal prohibited content. Steganography is a science exploring various methods of hiding information in multimedia objects, which should remain undetectable both statistically and for human perception. A large variety of video content can be used as a container to conceal information from unauthorized viewers. To solve this problem, the current research focus is on finding areas, where information can be hidden, or, in other words, areas inaccessible to human perception. The conference work proposes a new method and hardware-software system for creating a new assessment of the information capacity of compressed video sequences for information security systems, which would allow providing recommendations for the protection and detection of prohibited information in the network.

articleTitle: Possibilities of Using the Architecture of Neural Networks "Transformer" in Transport Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development of industry increasingly requires intelligent automation, while automation includes neural network technologies. This article discusses neural network technologies, the use of which can significantly improve the quality and automation. Today, many neural networks perform various highly specialized tasks, the greatest interest for the tasks of transport engineering may be the expansion of multimodality and versatility to solve various tasks. Computer vision is of the greatest interest, and NLP (Natural language processing) can also be included here. The scientific novelty of this work lies in the consideration of machine learning methods for solving many problems of transport engineering and the study of the possible future of these neural networks. The study examines modern architectures and their practical application in the field of transport engineering

articleTitle: Problems of ensuring the reliability of the time scale formed by the master clock
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Today, time synchronization systems that form and transmit time scales with accuracy within tens of ns are becoming increasingly relevant. The basis of such systems are complexes of devices that implement the functions of the master clock. Because since the time scale is not a physical quantity, then in any implementation of this clock, a channel for obtaining data on the UTC time scale is required. Due to various interferences and disturbances in this communication channel, the reliability of the reception of the UTC reference time scale can be violated, which leads to serious errors in the synchronization system and disruptions in the operation of communication networks. This article discusses some mechanisms for ensuring the reliability of data on the time scale formed by the master clocks of time synchronization systems.

articleTitle: Technology for Collecting and Data Processing of Street-Road Network Monitoring Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The scheme of monitoring objects of the street-road network using mobile road laboratories is described. Examples of the most successful domestic laboratories are given. The data flows and data exchange formats of the mobile complex of multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of the objects of the road network "Automated Road Scanner" are considered. The dependencies for predicting the international roughness, wheel tracking, and traction coefficient index are given. An original technology for a comprehensive assessment of the transport and operational condition of street and road network objects based on modern high-tech equipment, which can be used for all types of inspections, is described. A reasonable conclusion is made that the use of the proposed technology has significantly reduced the cost of monitoring and the number of errors in the detection of pavement defects. The study justified the use of the pavement condition index to decide on the assessment of its condition: normal, satisfactory, unsatisfactory, or emergency. The conclusion outlines the prospects for the development of research toward the creation and use of specialized decision support systems, providing the accumulation and use of data and knowledge in the subject area.

articleTitle: Some Features of AnyLogic Integration into the University’s Education System
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Anylogic is a simulation tool that can be used to build up a model of systems of any complexity. One of the advantages of simulation is a wide range of applications for education and training purposes. The development and use of simulation modeling allow students to see and "play out" real processes and situations on the model. With AnyLogic, the animation of a process in a telecommunication system can be created. At the same time it is possible to get diagrams of processes and states of different devices, as well as flowcharts of processes occurring in the systems. It can be used to generate a wide range of lab projects for undergraduate students. The principles of simulation modeling in telecommunication systems with the AnyLogic software are studied at Moscow Technical University of Communications and Informatics by students of Infocommunication Technologies and Communication Networks speciality.

articleTitle: Research of Resources Fiber-Optic Communication Lines Based on Wavelong Multiplexing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The effectiveness of the use network resources optical telecommunication systems using spectral technologies based on the architectural concept of the next NGN (Next Generation Network) and future FN (Future Network) networks has been studied. This work is devoted to the study methods and means of increasing the efficiency using network and channel resources fiber-optic communication lines using dense spectral multiplexing optical signals with separation communication channels. The problems of ensuring effective management channel and network resources in optical communication networks are considered. As a result of the study technology spectral multiplexing, a new approach to the construction of a calculation method is proposed that describes the efficiency of managing network and channel resources in fiber-optic communication lines, taking into account the numerous requirements their parameters and transfer characteristics. On the basis of the calculation method, analytical expressions are obtained that allow estimating the resources of the system, indicators informational and spectral efficiency of the functioning fiber-optic communication lines.

articleTitle: Determination of Optimal Maximum Usable Frequency Prediction Periods for Ionospheric Radio Channels Using the XGBoost Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An algorithm has been developed for applying the XGBoost machine learning method to solve the problem of predicting the maximum usable frequencies of shortwave communication channels with and without hyperparameter tuning. The optimal (minimum and maximum possible) periods for predicting the maximum usable frequencies are determined based on training samples compiled from radio sounding data of short-wave communication channels obtained using Ionosonde VSUT equipment. A database of machine learning models XGBoost was obtained for various combinations of hypermeters and forecast periods. The effectiveness of the development was verified for a mid-latitude radio path with a length of 2600 km using the MUF (Maximum usable frequency) dataset for thirty days.

articleTitle: Self-Directed Learning Optimisation Toolkits for Electronics and Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The organisation of self-directed foreign languages learning for the undergraduates in electronics and electrical engineering as a way of increasing their potential to adapt to the increasingly changing world is considered in the paper. The principal approaches to the content and selection of learning materials as well as available online education tools used by the authors during the two-year period of distance and blended learning are analysed. A toolkit based on the Padlet dashboard and used to generate a wide range of projects related to the English for specific purposes is given as an example of optimized students’ self-directed activities.

articleTitle: Results of the Assessment of the Adequacy of the Mathematical Model of the Hydrodynamic Transmission of a Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The choice of physical and mathematical models of the drive of vehicles with a hydrodynamic transformer is one of the most important and complex, since the choice of physical and mathematical models largely determines the reliability and accuracy of the results obtained. In the process of optimizing the objective function, the question of the reliability of the results obtained was solved, which is inextricably linked with the question of the adequacy of the mathematical model used. The analysis of literature sources showed that the issue of the adequacy of a mathematical model, such as used in optimization, is not covered enough. In this regard, a technique was developed for assessing the adequacy of the mathematical model used in determining the objective function. The assessment of the stability of the mathematical model and the statistical assessment of the possibility of its use in determining the integral indicators of the quality of a system with random loading confirmed the validity of using the proposed model for the analysis and synthesis of drive systems of vehicles equipped with torque converters.

articleTitle: Development of Models of Secretly Influence on the Wireless Networks Infrastructure Using Signal-Like Interference and Evaluation of Their Resistance to Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The object of research is IEEE 802.11 wireless networks, a physical environment of information interaction. The subject of the research is the effectiveness of covert influence on the infrastructure of wireless networks using signal–like interference. The purpose of the research is to develop the models of signal–like interference; methods and means of their creation, application scenarios; assessment of the stability of the generated signal-like interference and methods of their application to detection. The article analyzes scenarios in which, according to the 802.11 standard, information interaction sessions are destroyed by sending deauthentication frames. The developed hardware and software complex records such interaction, which is subsequently used as a signal-like interference. USRP NI 2901 acts as the hardware basis for recording and broadcasting signal samples, and NI LabVIEW 2018 acts as the software basis, with the help of which the USRP equipment is configured and controlled. Based on the analysis of numerous sources and the results of our own experimental researches, a system of signs used in the work to assess the stability of a signal-like interference to detection has been formed. The results of the study can be applied when setting up automatic network administration systems (IDS/IPS systems), which will allow timely detection of the impact, increasing the security of wireless communication networks.

articleTitle: Software Model of a 5G Data Transmission System with Increased Spectral Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At present, an actual task is to increase the throughput of cellular communication systems; in conditions of a limited frequency resource, the only solution is to increase the spectral efficiency of the signals used for data transmission. The signals used in the 5G system are based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing, which for channels with memory requires the use of a cyclic prefix that reduces the spectral efficiency by up to 7% depending on the mode of transmission. In this work, we have developed a model of a data transmission system based on a filterbank multicarrier, which made it possible to exclude the cyclic prefix, and the obtained simulation results showed noise immunity results similar to the existing solution.

articleTitle: Empirical Model for Studying Preferences in the Field of Intelligent Transport System of Europe
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper provides an overview of the empirical model for the study of meaningful integral assessments of residents of a European city in segment of intelligent transport system. It also provides details about theoretical base and practical basis of social life of modern society. In various countries, implementation of an intelligent transport system makes it possible to solve a variety of new and relevant developments for regulation of traffic flows, ensures a high level of safety for road users and competence regarding traffic situation. The development of a road safety system, improvement of services, comfort and advantages of passenger transportation is a considerable issue in implementing new transport technologies into social life. There is a direct interrelationship with key projects and proposals formulated as part of strategy for digital transformation of European transport industry. In a modern dynamic society, there is a modernization of socioeconomic state of transport directions, deployment of modern transport lines and roads, improvement of transport communications. Moreover, there are many other issues of functioning of intelligent transport systems. Most modern megacities are developing original projects in field of intelligent transport systems, as well as putting into practice technologies for improving road safety, artificial intelligence, communication and computer technologies, corporate portals, mobile devices - everything that is relevant in today's digital society and can be significant in the future. The paper proposes a tool for studying preferences in field of intelligent transport systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Flows in an Automotive Catalytic Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, predictions of laminar isothermal exhaust gas flows in an automotive catalytic converter are studied. The coupled calculations of incompressible viscous flows in the "porous medium−free flow" system were performed using generalized Navier-Stokes equations. The calculation algorithm for this model was implemented using the open software FEniCS. A typical converter geometry was considered in the two-dimensional planar formulation. Two cases with different monolith properties were calculated and compared. In the first case, the monolith was homogeneous and had the cell density of 400 CPSI (Cells per Square Inch) everywhere. In the second case, the monolith had two spatial zones − central and peripheral − which had cell densities of 900 CPSI and 400 CPSI, respectively. The calculations clearly demonstrated the possibility to control the flow uniformity in the monolith by constructing it with zones with different properties.

articleTitle: Application of the AVL CRUISE M Software Package for Modeling the Operation of an Engine as Part of a Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses possible areas of work in the software package for 1D modeling AVL Cruise M. An example of calculating the driving cycle of a passenger car with classic and hybrid power unit is given. The object of the study and the results of validation of its model are given. It is shown that the model has a high similarity with the real prototype. Acceleration to maximum speed and the NEDC driving cycle for both variants of the power unit are simulated. According to the calculation results, acceleration characteristics and maps of the main operating modes of the internal combustion engine are formed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Possibility of Using Optical Cables in Remote Control Systems Operating in Underwater Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study considers the possibility of using optical cables in remote control systems operated in underwater conditions. The operability of the optical microcable design to a hydrostatic pressure of 10 MPa has been confirmed. In order to determine the possibility of using optical microcables in seawater, they were exposed to salt solution simulating concentrated seawater of several versions of microcables. Graphs of the dependence of the attenuation coefficient on the exposure time in water with a salinity of 380‰ are given for all types of the studied samples. Using a microscope, the appearance of the outer coating of optical microcables and the quartz surface of the light guide after prolonged exposure to salt solution was examined. Thermogravimetric analysis and thermomechanical analysis of the studied samples are given.The frequency of forced Mandelstamm-Brillouin scattering (Brillouin frequency) in optical fibers of microcables was monitored. The results of the studies confirmed the possibility of using the developed microcables with dense protective coatings made of UV-cured acrylate in systems for remote control of underwater objects.

articleTitle: Attenuation of Laser Radiation in Wireless Underwater Laser Communication Channel Considering Transition between Media
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A series of experiments was carried out to measure the attenuation of laser radiation for four wavelengths of visible wavelength range on routes of different lengths in a water medium on the installation. The aim of the work was to estimate the loss of optical power of lasers in a water medium, taking into account the transition between media. In both cases, losses caused by transitions of laser radiation between different media (air-glass-water) were taken into account. Obtained experimental data was compared with two mathematical models for calculating the attenuation of the optical signal power in a wireless underwater laser communication channel. The data showed the need to refine mathematical models for pure fresh water.

articleTitle: Minimizing Distortion when Companding an Audio Signal in Transmission Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Existing channels for transmission and storage of a sound broadcast signal do not provide the ability to preserve the natural dynamic range. To save it, either compander systems are used, including a compressor and an expander that distort the signal shape, or an increase in the bit depth of the signal representation, which sharply increases the volume of the transmitted signal. An algorithm is proposed that ensures companding with maximum preservation of the signal shape while minimizing its volume.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrocardiosignals by Z Lead on Presence of Low-Amplitude High-Frequency Components
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Purpose of this study is effective registration of low-amplitude high-frequency components with predictive value - ventricular late potentials (VLPs) - in heart signals (ECS) by single Z lead. 206 signals were preliminary evaluated to detect VLPs by Simson’s method. VLPs were detected in 30 signals. In this study Simson’s algorithm was applicated to signals by Z lead. To realize that algorithm R-peak of heartbeat signal was used as synchronization point. VLPs were detected in 52 signals using designed algorithm. Originality: new approach to detect VLPs by single Z lead was designed. Opportunity to detect VLPs in signals by Z lead was evaluated: it is possible to register VLPs by single Z lead. Results of this research are practically significant: they can be integrated in onboard communication equipment related with telemedicine.

articleTitle: On the Task of Classifying Sound Patterns in Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers methods of collecting audio information about traffic events. The analysis of existing approaches to the extraction of audio patterns is given, the advantages and disadvantages are highlighted. The design of a neural network algorithm is performed. The requirements to the functionality of the data processing system are formed. A comparative analysis of the developed algorithm and examined its applicability to the task of classifying sound patterns in transportation. Ideas for further research to improve the performance of classification algorithms are formed.

articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Network Positioning Technology Design. Receiver Processing Procedures
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Purpose of software-defined radio (SDR) network positioning technology design is substantiation and experimental validation of new technical solutions for user equipment (UE) location estimation improvement, using infrastructure of existing 4G Long-Term Evolution (LTE) and emerging 5G New Radio (NR) networks, which is highly relevant in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denied urban environments. Approach for experimental validation is prototyping of eNodeB (eNB) reference signals transmission and UE reception procedures using SDR testbed with Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware and Matlab software. Generation and transmission of reference signals, performed by eNB on the physical layer, is defined by 3GPP technical specification 36.211, and receiver processing procedures, performed by UE, and strongly affecting the accuracy of primary measurements, can be designed as a proprietary solution. Findings of current research include formalization, software realization and results of experimental validation of a sequence of procedures for receiving and processing LTE reference signals in order to collect primary range-difference measurements on the UE side for observed time difference of arrival (OTDOA) positioning with developed SDR testbed. Research and development campaign on the current stage has limitation of SDR testbed validation only in laboratory conditions. Practical implications of developed UE SDR testbed allow to proceed campaign to the field conditions and test proposed technical solution with ambient LTE signals.

articleTitle: Development of a Mathematical Model for Analysis of the Information Structure of a Software-Defined Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problems associated with the analysis of the structures of software-defined optical networks (SDON) are considered. The aim of the article is to find the main characteristics of the structure of the SDON. The relevance of the work is due to the fact that it is the characteristics of the SDON structures that largely affect the quality of the modern services provided to the subscriber. The basic principles of the analysis of the structure of the SDON are formulated. To achieve this goal, the problems of describing the information structure of the SDON, as well as developing mathematical models for calculating the parameters of data flows in the information structure of the SDON, are solved. The proposed mathematical models make it possible to describe and calculate the characteristics of the information structure of the SDON: the intensity of data flows between network nodes, the load on the nodes and structure-forming network equipment.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of a Model of Group Receipt of IoT Elastic Data in a Wireless Access Node
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical model of the process of servicing by isolated cell of LTE standard a stream of sessions for elastic data transmission has been constructed and investigated. The model assumes that the sources of sessions including telemetry devices and video cameras with recording set by the system surveillance operator, which provides resources for transmitting the collected data to surveillance centers. The analyzed model takes into account that the data is transferred has elasticity, i.e. file transfer rates may vary within certain limits without service quality loss. This possibility is used in current and prospective wireless communication systems to increase the occupancy rate of the information transmission resource. The model also takes into account the impulsive nature of the process of receiving requests for data transmission. For this purpose, it is assumed that requests arrive in groups of random size. If the transfer rate of files under maintenance cannot be reduced, then the request received at that moment is rejected and is put on hold. It is assumed that the transmitted information is subject to aging. If the request has not been served within a certain time, the request is lost without renewal. Using the model, definitions are given for the main indicators of servicing requests, an algorithm for their evaluation is developed, and numerical examples are given that illustrate the use of the model to analyze the properties of elastic data transmission and estimate the required amount of resource to service incoming requests with a given quality.

Author Keywords: system of state equations recursive algorithms

articleTitle: Information Theory Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: the article discusses general approaches to the construction of pattern recognition algorithms based on the analysis of the recognition system in the information space. Based on the concept of interpreting an image as a set of geometric objects the problem of determining the correspondence of the image of a real object and its geometric model is considered. To increase the reliability of recognition, the problem of recognizing a scene image while compensating the information flow at the level of fuzzy sets is considered.

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of the Internet of Things Traffic Servicing in Case of its Impulse Nature
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of long-range Internet of Things technologies and the use of mathematical modeling to evaluate their characteristics. The Internet of Things is increasingly used in modern society. Automation of routine processes can reduce costs, increase production, and make people's lives more comfortable and safer. When implementing Internet of Things solutions, mobile operators actively use their networks and special technologies for machine-to-machine interaction. However, there is a problem of resource sharing between subscribers and smart devices. In order to optimally distribute frequency channels between these two categories of users, it is necessary to take into account the peculiarities of traffic transmission for each of them. To solve this problem, mathematical modeling should be used. In the article, the main long-range technologies are considered, the mathematical model of an LTE network cell and the main indicators of the quality of its functioning are given. Numerical experiments in case of impulse nature of the traffic are carried out.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Reliability of a Highly Loaded Vehicle Monitoring and Traffic Control Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the main approaches to solving problems of modern Enterprise systems working under heavy and constantly increasing load: processing and storage of large data, providing fault tolerance, increasing performance, the cheapest and fastest transition of the product to the state of readiness for real operation. Description of architectural solutions for the system under development, review of potential technologies used and justification of technological stack choice are performed. The process of implementing the distributed monitoring system, as well as the developed functionality is described and demonstrates the results of testing the main operating scenarios.

articleTitle: Autonomous Vehicles Safety Provision Before and During Operation on Public Roads
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes the admission process, as well as the procedure and composition of the required reporting on the operation of autonomous vehicles in Russia, the USA, and the countries of the European Union. The methods and relevant standards used by advanced developers of autonomous vehicles to ensure safety are described. Approaches to ensuring the safety of a highly automated vehicle developed by 'BaseTracK Rus' LLC are presented. The results of experimental operation of the developed highly automated vehicle on public roads are analyzed. Based on the comprehensive analysis, an approach is proposed to assess and improve the safety level of autonomous vehicles during operation, which will allow achieving a high level of safety before implementation on public roads, timely identify problems with the current version of the software and hardware of the automated control system during operation and effectively generate requests for improvements and improvements of the developed solutions for improving system performance, reliability and, accordingly, safety.

articleTitle: Intensification of Intelligent Automated Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article explores the methodology of complex analysis of ways effective management of production systems. A generalized approach to the decomposition of modern digital systems based on physical control actions, signal transmission ways and generalized principles of control system construction is investigated. Additional control physical effects act as one of the target factors of intensification. A generalized formulation of the problem of optimal control of complex multistage processes is proposed, considering the main perturbing processes and a piecewise-constant functions of the local tasks. Methods of search of new technical solutions by means of the morphological analysis as the tool of systemic and cybernetic approaches in scientific research are proved. Intensification of control systems is aimed at increasing their economic efficiency as a result on search for technological resources, of purposeful influence traffic flows and so on. The formulated principles of hierarchy, selectivity, openness, and mutual consistency, which are not exhaustive, but are closely interrelated and determine the application of methods of hierarchically interconnected control, considering the intensification of systems when choosing the control factors, as well as of physical impacts. The proposed approach leads to the possibility of intensification of high-tech industrial production processes and transport systems, and so can be implemented in the process of their technical operation. Identification of possible physical effects, synchronization of signals is a key factor in using the proposed methodology. The modular system of transport companies allows for flexible and transparent management of the system as a set of individual elements. Generalized goal-oriented models are applicable in many branches of industrial production, including the intensification of transport systems and business processes of enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of Risk Modeling to Assess the Effectiveness of Motor Transport Decarbonization
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The main source of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the transport sector is motor transport. The most effective measures for the decarbonization of vehicles include the use of gas motor fuel (GMF). It is proposed to evaluate the effectiveness of the implementation of these measures, related to the need to take into account both positive and negative effects that manifest themselves at different stages of the life cycle of vehicles using natural gas or hydrogen as fuel, it is proposed to implement by models based on a risk-oriented approach (complex risk). As initial data for modeling, using the data of intelligent transport systems (ITS) on vehicles, the results of evaluation for environmental risks associated with emissions of harmful substances and greenhouse gases, man-made risks of accidents during the maintenance and operation of vehicles and infrastructure, risks of overcoming organizational, technological and economic problems that hinder the widespread using of these alternative energy sources. It also evaluates the prospects for using ITS as security barriers to manage the security of vehicles and infrastructure and minimization of possible negative consequences in the implementation of the life cycle of vehicle and energy sources. Directions for improving the proposed modeling method are considered.

articleTitle: Development of the Spatial Model of an Urban Passenger Transport Route for the Safe Movement of Passenger Vehicles with a Partially Autonomous (Robotic) Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the issue of constructing a spatial analytical model of the route of a vehicle of urban passenger transport with an automated (robotic) control system. This model is necessary to ensure automatic control of the longitudinal and transverse movement of the vehicle while maintaining a safe speed in all areas, including complex spatial maneuvers. We propose to call such control systems robotic. Robotization of specific control functions inherent only to this type of ground passenger transport is a logical continuation of work on automation of vehicle control functions. The apparatus of theoretical mechanics, the theory of constructing Bezier curves is used as a methodological basis. The theory of Bezier curves allows you to describe the route of movement in three-dimensional space, which is important for countries, located in mountainous areas. This theory makes it possible to develop a compact description of the route trajectory, which can be loaded into the memory of the on-board computer via a radio channel on–line. Vehicle control system uses this information when moving along the route in a robotic mode. As a mechanism for practical implementation, it is planned to use modern software systems for transport geodesy.

Author Keywords: spatial model of an urban passenger transport route

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Security Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper aims at the interconnection between cyber security and artificial intelligence systems. In modern parlance, artificial intelligence systems are machine learning systems, the interpretation sometimes narrowed further to artificial neural networks. While machine learning increasingly penetrates into various spheres of information technology application, its intersection with cyber security is naturally to occur. The problem is that this intersection cannot be described by any single model. Combination of artificial intelligence and cyber security has a wide range of application. The common factor is obviously the use of machine learning techniques, but the objectives as well as the results achieved to date differ a lot. For example, with machine learning used to detect attacks and intrusions, real progress is made if compared to previous approaches; however, attacks on machine learning systems themselves cannot be combated by the system protection. The classification of models for applying machine learning to cyber security is the focus of this paper.

articleTitle: Resolution Time Theory Broadband Communications in Problem of Data Dependent Jitter in Frequency Selective Channels with PAM-n-Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At that moment the volume of transmitted data grows according to the exponential law through all available communication channels. In this regard, more and more often this leads to the need to work in data transfer mode at a speed higher than the Nyquist rate. In this article, resolution time theory is used to develop novel approach jitter analysis dependent on the data that contributes to the overall jitter in frequency selective channels with PAM-n-signals. A novel approach has the following features: 1) the computational complexity is sub-exponential in the amount of effective memory; 2) no restrictions associated with the shape of the pulse; 3) strict rule is given for estimating the channel memory when using PAM-n-signals, which does not use the rule of maximum a posterior probability

articleTitle: Optimization of Multi-Criteria Decision-Making Problems in Searching and Elimination of Vehicle Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the general decision-making process from a problem situation to an optimal solution, gives a mathematical description of the decision being made in the form of an efficiency criterion, the optimal value of which characterizes the decision being made. Various approaches and methods for finding the optimal values of the criteria are proposed. In this regard, the methods of linear and non-linear programming with their main features and scope are considered in order to be able to choose the appropriate method for determining the best value for all performance criteria for further providing this information to the decision maker. The optimization results are provided to the decision maker for analysis and assessment of the situation. The possibility of correcting the obtained values is also considered, considering the preferences of the decision maker. Thus, one of the possible approaches to the choice of mathematical support for the procedure for constructing a decision rule is considered.

articleTitle: The Time of Entering into Synchronism During Synchronization According to the Cyclic Prefix OFDM Symbols Formed by the Sum of Information and Multiphase Sequences
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, studies have been conducted to improve the synchronization efficiency by the peaks of the cyclic autocorrelation function of the cyclic prefix (CP) OFDM symbols of the LTE technology frame sent by the base station to the mobile user at the first synchronization stage. Three options for filling the CP and an equal number of elements of the end of the symbols of the frame are considered: the basic variant, when the CP is formed by transferring modulated elements of pseudorandom sequences (PRS) from the end of the symbol; the CP is formed from multiphase CAZAC (Constant amplitude zero autocorrelation waveform) sequences with the end of the symbols filled with the same sequences in the case of transmission by the station of "empty" symbols in the central part of the frequency range of the frame; the CP is formed from the sum of modulated PRS and multiphase sequences with the end of the symbols filled with the same sum of sequences in the case when the station does not transmit "empty" symbols in the central part of the frequency range of the frame. On the receiving side, the information of the end of OFDM symbols is restored in the devices of mobile users to whom the resources of the central frequency range of the LTE DL frame are distributed. The Zadoff–Chu (ZC) and Frank (Fr) sequences were used as multiphase CAZAC sequences; the PRS modulation types are QPSK or 64QAM. This study was carried out by simulation modeling in MATLAB for the Rayleigh communication channel model with delay profiles for the dense urban development (ETU) variant and with the addition of additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN); options for choosing the signal ratio/ noise SNR=0dB, 10dB, 50dB. The criterion for evaluating the effectiveness of one or another variant of filling the CP OFDM symbols are the results of calculations of the mathematical expectation of the search time and entering into synchronism and its variance.

Author Keywords: multiphase CAZAC (Constant amplitude zero autocorrelation waveform) sequences
average time of entry into synchronism

articleTitle: Some Aspects of the Synthesis of Automated Singularly Perturbed Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Researchers of numerous aspects of the implementation of optimal control over the past few decades have paid significant attention to solving problems related to the synthesis of object control systems, phenomena and processes of various nature, including such systems, the structure and content of which significantly change during their operation. Mathematical modeling of the processes of functioning of such systems, as a rule, is realized by forming systems of a large number of differential equations. At the same time, in order to ensure the quality of modeling and subsequent effective control of various objects, special attention is paid to the analysis of the properties of the set of coefficients of the above differential equations. In turn, the above circumstance necessitates a deep modernization of algorithms for solving the so-called "regular problems" of system synthesis. The purpose of this article is to develop a number of approaches and a set of algorithms that allow you to successfully synthesize adequate mathematical models of the so-called singular-perturbed systems in general, and in particular, their individual structural components. The methodology for implementing this scientific research is based on mathematical modeling and subsequent forecasting of the functioning of specific controlled objects and processes, as well as their control systems.

articleTitle: Management of the Processes of it Bachelors` Training in Technical Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The ability of society to synthesize modern knowledge and successfully apply it in practice in all areas of activity assumes special importance under modern difficult conditions. This relevant knowledge is a kind of driver for the formation of the scientific and technical potential of the state, as well as ensuring the quality of the population's life, safety, and well-being of society as a whole. The leading role in the implementation of such processes now belongs to higher education. The effectiveness of the implementation of a hierarchical set of educational processes determines the quality of absolutely all processes in society. Modern information and communication technologies (ICT) make it possible to create unique conditions and opportunities for the synthesis of innovative knowledge. However, the achievement of the relevant goals (organizational, technological, economic, financial, social, political, etc.) is determined not only by the available conditions (favourable and not favorable) for the implementation of a particular activity but primarily by the effectiveness of their management. Managing the objects, phenomena and processes in the education sector, based on the ideas of both systemic and cybernetic approaches, involves the formalization of a set of goals that must be achieved as the final result, and the processes for implementing a targeted impact (influence) on management objects, as well as criteria for evaluating the effectiveness of the implementation of this activity. In fact, a hierarchical set of models of educational processes and systems should be synthesized, the key moment for the creation of which is the hypothesis of some correlation between the parameters of the control actions of the management entity and the gradient of the parameters` state of the educational system itself, as an object of management. The purpose of this article is to develop and substantiate a methodology for the implementation of the synthesis of a certain category from a very complex hierarchy of models of educational processes and systems that would ensure the quality and efficiency of their functioning, as well as success in achieving educational goals.
